digest.component_or_area: LLM runner telemetry / GitHub Actions CI
propositions: Token usage from live LLM calls in weekly external and eval-live jobs is not captured or retrievable; usage data is computed but dropped before reaching CI output.

PydanticAIRunner.run computes and logs usage (input/output/cache tokens, requests) but the record never surfaces because eval paths return only results without _usage, pytest swallows INFO logs due to NullHandler, and Langfuse traces are ephemeral.
A new usage_log.py module must provide opt-in recording via REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var (JSONL sink) and a summarize CLI to produce human and machine-readable summaries for CI job artifacts.

Both weekly workflows (external-integration.yml and prompt-eval.yml) must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG, call summarize after test/eval steps, append output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, and upload the JSONL artifact.
Recording must be a non-breaking telemetry sink (best-effort, wrapped in try/except, never raises into LLM call path) and remain transparent when the env var is unset.
